content:
DONE — .github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml has been created and committed on main.

Now verify end to end:

1. Confirm the workflow file exists on GitHub.
2. Return the commit SHA.
3. Trigger workflow_dispatch with:
   - testsTarget = backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts backend/ivx-timezone.test.ts
   - buildApk = false
4. Confirm backend-tests completes successfully.
5. Trigger workflow_dispatch again with:
   - testsTarget = default
   - buildApk = true
6. Confirm Android APK build completes successfully.
7. Return:
   - workflow run IDs
   - run URLs
   - job results
   - test totals
   - APK artifact name
   - APK size
   - APK SHA-256
   - source commit SHA
8. Confirm the artifact downloads successfully.
9. Confirm the workflow is now part of the permanent owner-controlled CI/CD pipeline.
10. Update the closeout ledger and continue with the remaining blocked items without restarting the audit.
